n5e32aa062d.headline: Tanzania's ban on foreigners operating small businesses sparks Kenyan backlash
n5e32aa062d.summary: Tanzania has barred foreign nationals from owning and operating mainly small-scale businesses, prompting concern and a backlash from neighbouring Kenya.
n5e32aa062d.why: Restrictions on foreign ownership affect investment, trade and business operations across East Africa. Policy changes like this shape the risk profile for investors in the region.

nfb61fab098.headline: Fiverr's (NYSE:FVRR) Q2: Beats On Revenue But Full-Year Sales Guidance Slightly Misses Expectations
nfb61fab098.summary: Fiverr reported second-quarter revenue above expectations, but its full-year sales guidance came in slightly below analyst forecasts.
nfb61fab098.why: Fiverr is a listed online freelance marketplace, and its guidance is closely watched by investors as a gauge of demand for digital services.

nb44261ed23.headline: Top diplomats, industry experts back stronger defence industrial cooperation between India and EU
nb44261ed23.summary: Top diplomats and industry experts said defence industrial cooperation between India and the European Union is becoming central to both regions' strategic outlooks.
nb44261ed23.why: Defence industrial ties determine procurement, co-production and export flows between governments and their defence manufacturers.

n7a7d42892a.headline: African startups take on medicine access gaps with smarter supply chains
n7a7d42892a.summary: A healthcare panel at the Sapics Conference in Cape Town highlighted Africa's emergence as a source of health supply chain innovations with global potential.
n7a7d42892a.why: Health supply chain technology addresses distribution gaps for medicines, an area where startups increasingly partner with governments and private healthcare buyers.

n97171778bc.headline: Santander to cut UK jobs, close branches despite record group profit
n97171778bc.summary: Santander UK said it will cut more than 2,000 jobs and close more branches as part of a cost-reduction programme. First-half pre-tax profit fell 5% to £764m despite record group profit.
n97171778bc.why: Santander UK is the British arm of the Spanish banking group Banco Santander. Cost cuts and profit trends affect its earnings and the parent group's results.

n3984e69ad6.headline: 4,557 EV public charging stations installed on highways and expressways: Nitin Gadkari
n3984e69ad6.summary: Minister Nitin Gadkari told Parliament that 4,557 public EV charging stations have been installed across 146,342 km of state, national and expressways.
n3984e69ad6.why: Public charging infrastructure is a key condition for electric vehicle adoption. Government build-out affects demand for EVs, charging operators and power utilities.

n6443251903.headline: Lipa Later sought $5 million from UK lender two weeks after entering administration
n6443251903.summary: A term sheet seen by TechCabal shows Lipa Later sought a $5 million facility from UK-based Advanced Global Capital in April to support its invoice factoring business. The proposed loan carries a 14% annual interest rate.
n6443251903.why: Lipa Later is a Nigerian buy-now-pay-later fintech. Its funding terms show the financing pressures facing African fintech lenders.

nedaa1f9c74.headline: Angola's petrol protest death toll rises as medics overwhelmed
nedaa1f9c74.summary: At least 22 people, including a police officer, have been killed and 200 injured in protests against a fuel price rise that began on Monday, Interior Minister Manuel Homem said.
nedaa1f9c74.why: Fuel subsidy reforms and price increases in oil-exporting African economies can trigger social unrest that affects government policy, fiscal plans and investor sentiment on the country.

nf4d7d70ade.headline: Brazilian Oil May Head to Asia, Europe if Trump Enacts Tariffs
nf4d7d70ade.summary: Brazil's crude oil exports to the U.S. face an uncertain future as Washington prepares to impose 50% tariffs on Brazilian imports from August 1, up from 10%.
nf4d7d70ade.why: Brazil is one of the largest oil producers in Latin America, and US tariffs on its exports can redirect crude flows and shift regional trade patterns.

n29cb1c3f51.headline: Chinese battery maker CATL reports faster profit growth in second quarter
n29cb1c3f51.summary: CATL reported faster profit growth in the second quarter. Authorities said they will toughen regulations to halt price wars amid fierce competition in China's auto market.
n29cb1c3f51.why: CATL, based in Ningde, is the world's largest maker of electric vehicle batteries, so its results reflect demand from global automakers.

n226de09942.headline: Santander Brasil Slows While Global Group Posts Record Profits
n226de09942.summary: Santander Brasil reported second-quarter 2025 net profit of R$3.66 billion, slowing, while parent Santander Group posted record profits globally.
n226de09942.why: Santander Brasil is the Brazilian unit of Spain's Santander, one of the largest banks in Latin America, and its results signal credit and margin trends in Brazil.

n5a163d0546.headline: HMRC sending letters to 1.4 million Brits who need to pay up on their income
n5a163d0546.summary: HMRC will issue 1.4 million letters over the next couple of months for the 2024 to 2025 tax year. The letters concern people who need to pay tax on their income.
n5a163d0546.why: HM Revenue & Customs is the UK tax authority, and self-assessment and unpaid tax collection affect household finances and public revenue.

na12808f10a.headline: AI bookkeeping startup Ceedar is turning customers into investors
na12808f10a.summary: AI bookkeeping startup Ceedar has taken angel cheques from Canadian founders looking for simplified accounting options. The round involves its own customers becoming investors.
na12808f10a.why: Ceedar is a small accounting software startup, and angel rounds from customers are a sign of early-stage capital formation in Canadian fintech.

n6edc54f4ab.headline: Greek parliament approves investigative committee into OPEKEPE amid accusations of cover-up
n6edc54f4ab.summary: The Greek parliament approved a three-month investigative committee into OPEKEPE, the agricultural subsidy agency, amid opposition accusations of a cover-up by the government.
n6edc54f4ab.why: OPEKEPE distributes EU agricultural subsidies in Greece, so probes into its handling affect public funds and farm payments.

nb094ea09c8.headline: IndiGo profit falls 20% to Rs 2,176 crore in June quarter - OrissaPOST
nb094ea09c8.summary: IndiGo, India's largest airline, reported a 20% fall in June-quarter profit after tax to Rs 2,176.3 crore. The carrier posted Rs 2,728.8 crore in the year-ago period.
nb094ea09c8.why: IndiGo is India's largest airline by passenger traffic, so its earnings reflect fare levels, fuel costs, and domestic air travel demand.

source.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

sources.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

n2d0d80722d.headline: Qatar Central Bank grants Express Sandbox entry approval to Paywise LLC (Dibsy)
n2d0d80722d.summary: Qatar Central Bank has granted Paywise LLC, operating as Dibsy, entry approval to its Express Sandbox. Paywise offers open banking-powered payment initiation services.
n2d0d80722d.why: Regulatory sandboxes let fintech firms test new payment products under central bank supervision. They shape how open banking develops in Qatar's financial sector.

ne7b8863f22.headline: Shelf Drilling Announces Two-Year Contract Extension in West Africa
ne7b8863f22.summary: Shelf Drilling announced a two-year contract extension for the Adriatic I jack-up rig in West Africa. The extension secures continued utilisation of the rig.
ne7b8863f22.why: Shelf Drilling is an offshore drilling contractor, and multi-year rig contracts give visibility on its future revenue.

n92db30ad7e.headline: Palm Oil Futures Stir Interest Amid Shifting Rival Oil Dynamics
n92db30ad7e.summary: Palm oil futures are gaining support from shifting trade dynamics, currency trends and strength in rival oils. The report describes a more favourable structural setup for the commodity.
n92db30ad7e.why: Palm oil is a major edible oil and biofuel feedstock, and its prices affect food producers and consumers across Asia and beyond.

n2b3f9f0454.headline: RHI Magnesita lowers guidance after tough first half
n2b3f9f0454.summary: RHI Magnesita lowered its full-year profit guidance after a steep drop in first-half 2025 earnings. Deferred industrial projects, weaker pricing and cost pressures weighed on margins.
n2b3f9f0454.why: RHI Magnesita makes refractory products used in steel and industrial furnaces, so its results reflect activity in heavy industry.

n058d00317c.headline: IndiGo’s Q1 net profit slumps 29 pc sequentially, revenue falls nearly 7.5 pc
n058d00317c.summary: InterGlobe Aviation, parent of budget airline IndiGo, reported a 29% quarter-on-quarter fall in consolidated net profit to Rs 2,176 crore for the June 2025 quarter. Revenue fell nearly 7.5%.
n058d00317c.why: InterGlobe Aviation is the parent of IndiGo, India's largest airline by passengers, so its quarterly results signal conditions in Indian air travel.

n1af21ac0f2.headline: Repricing Unfolds Across Europe As Trade Pressures Ease
n1af21ac0f2.summary: A new transatlantic trade deal has eased tariff pressures and sparked renewed interest in European and Asian exporters, according to DirectorsTalk.
n1af21ac0f2.why: Tariffs directly affect export margins and the valuations of exporters, so trade agreements can reprice sectors across regions.
n1af21ac0f2.why_moved: A new transatlantic trade deal eased tariff pressures, which prompted renewed interest in European and Asian exporters.

neef25f8120.headline: Indian stock market settles in green ahead of US Fed meet
neef25f8120.summary: The Indian stock market ended Wednesday's session with a decent gain amid mixed global cues. Investors also weighed uncertainty over a potential India-US trade deal ahead of an August 1 deadline.
neef25f8120.why: India's benchmark indices track the country's largest listed companies, and the Federal Reserve's policy decisions shape global capital flows into emerging markets like India.
neef25f8120.why_moved: Investors weighed mixed global cues ahead of the US Federal Reserve meeting. Uncertainty over a possible India-US trade deal before the August 1 deadline also featured.

n5fe716518c.headline: UBS more-than-doubles second-quarter net profit
n5fe716518c.summary: UBS more than doubled its second-quarter net profit to $2.4bn, beating market expectations. Strong trading revenues and client inflows in wealth management offset weaker investment banking.
n5fe716518c.why: UBS is a Swiss global bank and one of the largest wealth managers, so its quarterly results signal conditions across international banking and markets.

nfde3522df0.headline: NNPCL has resumed Kolmani River II oil well drilling -  Yahaya
nfde3522df0.summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited has resumed crude oil drilling at the Kolmani River II field, Gombe State governor Inuwa Yahaya said. The governor made the statement on Tuesday.
nfde3522df0.why: NNPC Ltd is Nigeria's state oil company, and new drilling affects the country's crude output and fiscal revenue.

n549a2a3124.headline: BAE Systems Upgrades 2025 Outlook After Strong H1 Performance
n549a2a3124.summary: BAE Systems reported first-half sales up 11% to £14.6bn and underlying EBIT up 13% to £1.55bn. The company upgraded its full-year sales and profit guidance.
n549a2a3124.why: BAE Systems is a British defence and aerospace group, and its guidance reflects demand from government defence budgets worldwide.

impacts.name: BAE Systems
impacts.why: Half-year results beat expectations and the company raised full-year sales and profit guidance.

ndb1b4d4416.headline: Rate cut outlook firms as RBA gets the 'outstanding' inflation data it was waiting for
ndb1b4d4416.summary: Annual trimmed mean inflation came in at its lowest level since 2021, the data the Reserve Bank governor said it was waiting for. The result firms the outlook for a rate cut.
ndb1b4d4416.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, and trimmed mean inflation is its preferred measure of underlying price pressure.
ndb1b4d4416.why_moved: Trimmed mean inflation at its lowest level since 2021 gave the central bank the data it had been waiting for, firming the outlook for a rate cut.

ne9265de351.headline: Ecobank Group reports $398m Profit Before Tax, $1.1bn in Net Revenue in first half of 2025
ne9265de351.summary: Ecobank Group reported unaudited first-half 2025 profit before tax up 23% year on year to $398 million, with net revenue of $1.1 billion and a cost-to-income ratio of 49.1%.
ne9265de351.why: Ecobank is a pan-African banking group, and its results indicate profitability and efficiency across its markets in Africa.

neded2b46a4.headline: China's leaders vow economy help as US talks in limbo
neded2b46a4.summary: Beijing's top leaders are promising help for companies hit by higher tariffs and vowing to stabilise foreign investment. The commitments come as talks with the US remain inconclusive.
neded2b46a4.why: China is the world's second-largest economy and a central node in global supply chains, so its policy signals on trade and foreign investment affect global markets and multinational earnings.

n72f1c88cc7.headline: Pokies giant taken to court over money laundering gaps
n72f1c88cc7.summary: A financial regulator is launching legal action against Mounties, a club operating about 1,400 poker machines, over alleged gaps in money laundering controls.
n72f1c88cc7.why: Clubs and gaming operators are subject to anti-money-laundering rules, and enforcement actions can bring large penalties and compliance costs.

n2455a07752.headline: 'I won't be bullied': Labor leader given a day to support $5 billion Marinus decision
n2455a07752.summary: Labor, the Greens and new independent members of Tasmania's parliament are frustrated by the time allowed to digest a $5 billion investment decision on Marinus Link.
n2455a07752.why: Marinus Link is a planned undersea electricity interconnector between Tasmania and Victoria, a large energy infrastructure project with significant public funding. Major infrastructure decisions affect energy supply costs and project developers.

n2b10563338.headline: Costa Rica’s job boom vs USA hiring plateau: What it means for young professionals - Times of India
n2b10563338.summary: Costa Rica topped the Americas for job growth in Q3 2025 with a 41% Net Employment Outlook, outpacing the United States, according to the report.
n2b10563338.why: The Net Employment Outlook is a hiring-intention survey of employers, giving an early read on labour-market momentum and consumer demand.

nf39f9d995a.headline: In game-changing climate rollback, EPA aims to kill a bedrock scientific finding
nf39f9d995a.summary: The Environmental Protection Agency aims to kill a bedrock scientific finding in what is described as a game-changing climate rollback.
nf39f9d995a.why: The EPA sets federal environmental rules, and its climate findings underpin emissions regulation that affects energy and industrial companies.

nd3ce134767.headline: 'We Are Not Social Media': YouTube Responds To Australia Banning The Platform For Youth Under 16
nd3ce134767.summary: Australia has banned YouTube for users under 16, reversing an earlier exemption. The move expands a landmark social media law aimed at protecting young people from harmful content.
nd3ce134767.why: YouTube is owned by Alphabet, and social media age restrictions affect platform user numbers, advertising reach and regulatory risk across the sector.

nec087cbf0f.headline: 'Ruling the roost more than ever': Former Energy Minister rips into Big Four power companies
nec087cbf0f.summary: A former Energy Minister criticised New Zealand's Big Four power companies for dominating the market. Some see market reform as the only real way to bring power prices down.
nec087cbf0f.why: The Big Four generators and retailers control much of New Zealand's electricity supply, so their pricing and market structure directly affect household and business power costs.

nf5f2f5989d.headline: Starbucks execs say
nf5f2f5989d.summary: Starbucks reported lower earnings, though results were near analyst expectations. The description provided is incomplete, so further details on the results are not available.
nf5f2f5989d.why: Starbucks is a global coffee chain whose quarterly results are closely watched as a gauge of consumer spending in restaurants and retail.

nff7161e6ed.headline: Aston Martin downgrades FY profit outlook, cites tariff disruption
nff7161e6ed.summary: Aston Martin Lagonda lowered its full-year profit outlook on Wednesday, pointing to disruption from US tariffs.
nff7161e6ed.why: Aston Martin is a British luxury carmaker whose profits are sensitive to export markets such as the US and to tariff costs.

n5875f0fe07.headline: Indonesia to raise tax rate on crypto transactions
n5875f0fe07.summary: Indonesia will raise taxes on cryptocurrency transactions from August 1, with a higher rate on trades hosted by overseas exchanges, under a new finance ministry regulation.
n5875f0fe07.why: Transaction taxes change trading costs and the attractiveness of local versus offshore crypto exchanges.

n67d8cce80e.headline: Club Med appoints Stéphane Maquaire as President and CEO
n67d8cce80e.summary: The board of Club Med Holding appointed Stéphane Maquaire as president and chief executive officer of Club Med. Further details were not provided.
n67d8cce80e.why: Club Med is a global holiday resort operator, and leadership changes can signal shifts in its strategy and results.

n4429b65ba1.headline: Rio Tinto profits slip as prices weigh on performance
n4429b65ba1.summary: Rio Tinto posted its weakest first-half profit in years as lower prices weighed on its performance. The iron ore miner is one of the largest in the world.
n4429b65ba1.why: Rio Tinto is a major iron ore and aluminium producer, so its profits track commodity prices closely.

impacts.name: Rio Tinto
impacts.why: Lower commodity prices reduced the miner's first-half profit to its weakest in years.

n28065e793e.headline: Dutch banks increase financing for SMEs
n28065e793e.summary: Major Dutch banks are investing more in SMEs after years of restrictions, according to NLInvesteert, which has arranged about 1.3 billion euros in SME financing since 2015. Banks are also increasingly involved in platform investments.
n28065e793e.why: Bank lending to small and medium-sized enterprises is a key channel for business investment and economic growth in the Netherlands.

nba9f407541.headline: Govt mulls law reform to support Reset strategy against private healthcare inflation
nba9f407541.summary: Malaysia's government is reviewing existing legislation, including an amendment to the Private Healthcare Facilities and Services Act 1998. The changes aim to support the Reset strategy against healthcare inflation.
nba9f407541.why: Regulation of private healthcare pricing affects hospital operators and insurers, which are investable sectors in Malaysia.

n5752dea298.headline: Trump’s economy is already proving the doomsayers completely wrong
n5752dea298.summary: The US economy grew at a 3% rate in the second quarter, with all of the growth coming from the private sector while the government portion shrank. The data counters earlier recession forecasts.
n5752dea298.why: GDP growth is the broadest measure of US economic output and shapes Federal Reserve policy expectations, interest rates and corporate earnings outlooks.

nc1f111e134.headline: Trump Says US To Impose 15% Tariff On South Korean Goods
nc1f111e134.summary: President Donald Trump said the US will impose a 15% tariff on imports from South Korea, describing it as part of a full and complete trade deal between the two countries. The announcement was made on Wednesday.
nc1f111e134.why: US tariffs on Korean goods affect exporters such as Samsung and Hyundai and the trade flows underpinning South Korea's economy.
nc1f111e134.why_moved: The US tariff on South Korean goods is framed as part of a trade deal, which sets the terms of bilateral trade.

n2ade10d7fb.headline: Medicine price display rule to proceed on Aug 1, says Health Minister
n2ade10d7fb.summary: Health Minister Dzulkefly Ahmad said the medicine price display rule will proceed on August 1, despite a judicial review filed by doctors.
n2ade10d7fb.why: Drug price display rules affect pharmacies, clinics and pharmaceutical retail pricing transparency in Malaysia's healthcare market.

n1f2e88d9f6.headline: S. Korea launches joint task force against stock manipulation
n1f2e88d9f6.summary: A joint task force of financial authorities and the stock market operator started work on Wednesday. It is a follow-up step aimed at quickly detecting and rooting out stock manipulation.
n1f2e88d9f6.why: Market manipulation enforcement affects investor confidence and the integrity of pricing on the Korea Exchange. Regulatory crackdowns can change trading behaviour in the affected market.

na6c3750425.headline: Pakistan’s Agricultural Crisis
na6c3750425.summary: The Pakistan Kissan Ittehad warned about deteriorating conditions in the agricultural sector. It cited neglect, soaring production costs and ineffective policy implementation.
na6c3750425.why: Agriculture is a large share of Pakistan's economy and employment, so farm input costs and policy failures affect food prices, exports and rural incomes.

n32467a98bc.headline: GDP beats expectations, but tariff impacts swing measure of economy
n32467a98bc.summary: US gross domestic product increased at a 3% annual rate in the second quarter, above the 2.3% median forecast. Tariff effects were cited as complicating the picture of the economy.
n32467a98bc.why: GDP is the broadest measure of US economic output and shapes expectations for Federal Reserve policy, interest rates and corporate earnings.

n8b606ba36c.headline: Procter & Gamble projects $1 billion hit from Trump's tariffs
n8b606ba36c.summary: Procter & Gamble warns of $1 billion in additional costs from President Trump's tariffs. The company said the costs could affect consumer prices.
n8b606ba36c.why: Procter & Gamble is a large US consumer goods maker, so tariff-driven input costs affect its margins and pricing.

n151f287605.headline: Canadian Stock Index Declines Amid Prolonged Tariff Uncertainty
n151f287605.summary: Canadian stocks fell steeply on Wednesday as a month of US-Canada trade talks produced no breakthrough ahead of the August 1 deadline. The market reaction followed the lack of progress.
n151f287605.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, and it is sensitive to trade policy because of the country's export and resource exposure.
n151f287605.why_moved: Trade talks between the US and Canada have not produced a breakthrough, leaving tariff uncertainty ahead of the August 1 deadline.

n2db1002a8d.headline: Bank of Canada holds key rate at 2.75% but opens door to future cuts
n2db1002a8d.summary: The Bank of Canada left its policy rate unchanged at 2.75%, its third consecutive hold. It said future cuts may be warranted as US tariffs continue to cloud the outlook.
n2db1002a8d.why: The Bank of Canada sets the overnight policy rate that anchors borrowing costs, mortgage rates and the Canadian dollar.
n2db1002a8d.why_moved: The bank held rates steady but signalled that cuts may come if US tariffs keep clouding the outlook, which bears on yields and the currency.

nd741a043c6.headline: NSE crosses 23 crore investor accounts, adds 1 crore investors in just 3 months
nd741a043c6.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India has crossed 230 million unique trading accounts, adding 10 million investors since April.
nd741a043c6.why: NSE is India's largest stock exchange; rapid investor growth indicates expanding market participation and potential liquidity increases.

n532932dab3.headline: Apple, Samsung drive record value for Indian smartphone market in Q2 2025 - BusinessToday
n532932dab3.summary: India's smartphone market grew 8% year-on-year in Q2 2025, led by strong sales from Apple and Samsung, marking a recovery after a slow first quarter.
n532932dab3.why: India is a key growth market for global smartphone makers; market performance signals consumer demand and technology adoption trends.

impacts.why: Strong sales growth boosts revenue and market position.
